baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Hi everyone, I’m bring you a huge minecraft map this time ! Both cod and minecraft are my favorite games, so I take my survival base in minecraft here. And this is my second map, just enjoy! Thanks to FirstBlood so that I can have smoe super cool weapons in my map. And at the same time, thanks to Klaudeh’s kindly help, without him this map can’t be so beautiful. Attention again： Remember zombies within 500 range of Brutus are immune to the effects of the wonderWeapon. So don’t ask” Why my thundergun/blackhole/mk3 doesn’t work” all the time. You can end this protection by knocking Brutus’s hat off. Tips： 1.If you have deadshot-daiquiri, your headshot makes more damage 2.if you have double-tap, most of your weapons have increased damage 3.While in water, you are immune to fall damage 4.Tombstone-soda is a modified version that gives you a second chance whether single or multiplayer, so it is expensive 5.All wonder weapons can cause damage to bosses, they just can’t kill the boss instantly. 6.Vulture mist is not wrong, it requires you to stand in it for a short while to take effect (not immediately), the zombies will not attack you, but will still follow you 7.Look at your friends and Press and hold F for a while to trade weapon or give them money!(Quickly tap F), so you can pool your points on one player to buy arena. Change log： V1.3.2: Don’t mind my frequent updates. Save/load feature still have small bugs, so i fix them(They don’t affect your gameplay a lot, but I can’t stan

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc, maps/_utility.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). The scanner found easter-egg state; WHICH combination means done is a human's call, so the finish is {"manual": true} and the Round 20 fallback applies meanwhile. PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
